name: hoeL_iron_1
what: an iron hoe: bright warm-silver iron with a near-white bevel along the blade's edge, a gold collar, the long handle wrapped in red-brown leather with gold cross-bands and a round gold pommel. Shaped like a real garden hoe and like Minecraft's: the handle runs from the bottom-left corner up toward the top-right; at its top end a short neck reaches out to ONE side only (toward the upper left), and from the neck's end a flat blade turns DOWN toward the handle, so the head is an L, never a T: nothing sticks out past the handle on the other side. The blade is about 8 px long and 3-4 px wide. 2 px margin from the canvas sides; no straight vertical edge
